title: Rabbi Chana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Ketubot 61a: “Rabbi Chana said — and some say Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani — she did not literally bring in to him,” etc. Likewise in Bava Kamma 51a: “Rabbi Chana said — and some say Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani — what is the meaning of what is written, ‘long-suffering’?” etc. (In Eruvin 22a the reading is Rabbi Chaggai.) Hyman considers this Rabbi Chana likely to have been a Palestinian, and he is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:7: “Rabbi Chanah, Rabbi Yirmeyah in the name of Rabbi Chiyya (bar Abba).”

notes.text: The supplied Rabbi Chana is retained against saved Davidson Ketubot 61a’s full Rav Chana. The alternative attribution to Rabbi Shmuel bar Nachmani remains. Sotah 7:7 is Jerusalem Talmud, and the Palestinian identity inference is Hyman’s.
